title: Creamy Yogurt Porridge
description: A light, tangy oat porridge made creamy by stirring through probiotic yogurt.
steps: Cook the oats in the water over low heat, or microwave 3 minutes, until thick.
Stir through the yogurt, or swirl half in and top with the rest.
Serve warm with your preferred toppings.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food creamy yogurt porridge

notes: The fastest recipe in the book — good for mornings when 4 minutes is all you have.
